svg.title: Genesis saves, bottom net
svg.text: Genesis saves, bottom net: the body circle and the stick, in each save pose
To scale, the goalie facing up, with the game's own pictures. The save frames move only the stick's spot (and the pad stack's body);
the body circle is the same in every pose. The moves to his left are these mirrored.
Blue: the body. A puck 15 high or lower within his reach of his centre is stopped: 12-15 by Agility (13 drawn), 15 with a person in net (dashed),
12 against a one-timer, 18 in a pad stack (its centre moved 6 toward the stacked pads).
Green: the stick's hot point. A puck 5 high or lower within 8 of it is played: caught under 13,000, deflected faster.
Orange: 8-14 from the hot point nothing is tested that frame, not even the body: the blind ring (through the legs).
The pose moves only the stick (and the pad stack's body); unlike the SNES, a save move doesn't make the goalie bigger.
At the bottom net the shoulder save's hold point is in front of him, so no shoulder-save bobble.
